name: Preciousuite Gold Savings Scheme
author: Vimal Kava

sections.description:
Gold Scheme allows jewelry stores to run gold savings schemes where customers can pay monthly installments and redeem them for jewelry at the end of the term.

Features include:
* Create multiple types of savings schemes
* Fixed amount or gold weight based schemes
* Integration with WooCommerce for checkout and redemption
* KYC verification support
* Customer dashboard for tracking installments
* Admin dashboard for managing schemes and enrollments

External Services

This plugin integrates with Razorpay to process installment payments for gold savings plans.
– Razorpay API (https://api.razorpay.com) is used to create and verify order transactions securely.
– Razorpay Checkout SDK (https://checkout.razorpay.com) is enqueued on the frontend to render the payment gateway form for users.
– Razorpay’s Terms of Service: https://checkout.razorpay.com
– Razorpay’s Privacy Policy: https://razorpay.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/preciousuite-gold-savings-scheme directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the settings under the Gold Scheme menu in the admin dashboard.
